rules.name: High Transaction Velocity
rules.description: More than 5 transactions from the same address within 1 hour
rules.message: High velocity: more than {max_count} transactions in {window_seconds}s window

rules.name: Large Cumulative Amount (24h)
rules.description: Cumulative transaction amount exceeds 10,000 USDC in a 24-hour window

rules.name: Single Large Transaction
rules.description: Single transaction amount exceeds 50,000 units of any currency
rules.message: Single transaction amount {amount} exceeds threshold of {threshold}

rules.name: Suspicious Counterparty
rules.description: Transaction involves a known suspicious address (e.g. mixer service)
rules.message: Address {address} is on the suspicious counterparty blocklist

rules.name: High-Risk Country
rules.description: Transaction originates from or involves a high-risk jurisdiction (risk level 3)

rules.name: Medium-Risk Country
rules.description: Transaction involves a medium-risk jurisdiction (risk level 2)
